name: hcapp_getEventMessageCounts
description: Returns unread event message counts for all events where the calling user has badge count records. Uses PublicHasherId for filtering (not internal hasherId). Validates deviceId by DATALENGTH — meaningless for UNIQUEIDENTIFIER type.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device UUID for auth lookup. Validated by DATALENGTH() = 16 — always true for a valid UNIQUEIDENTIFIER.

rowsets.name: NullDeviceIdError
rowsets.description: Returned when deviceId is NULL or DATALENGTH != 16. Standard error format. Note: the guard emits the SELECT but does NOT RETURN, so subsequent checks may also emit errors. errorType=2.

rowsets.name: NullHasherError
rowsets.description: Returned when Device lookup yields no userId. Standard error format. errorType=2.

rowsets.name: MessageCounts
rowsets.description: One row per event where the user has unread messages (based on EventMessageBadgeCounts records). Empty if no events.

codeSmells.issue: Error checks do not RETURN — multiple error rowsets possible
codeSmells.detail: The null deviceId and null hasherId checks emit the error SELECT but don't call RETURN. Only the auth check has RETURN. If deviceId is null AND hasherId resolves to null, two error rowsets are emitted.

codeSmells.issue: DATALENGTH check on UNIQUEIDENTIFIER is meaningless
codeSmells.detail: DATALENGTH(@deviceId) = 16 for any non-null UNIQUEIDENTIFIER. This check only catches NULL, not malformed values.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
